clips.title: The story
paras: Tallonkai Swiftroot sends trusted champions into Fel Rock to stop Lord Melenas. The satyr has rallied the cave’s grell into an organized force, threatening night elf settlements near Teldrassil.

Satyrs recall an ancient betrayal that still stains kaldorei history. They were Highborne who gave themselves to the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. Now one has made a foothold on Teldrassil, the young World Tree meant to be a sanctuary. For defenders like Tallonkai Swiftroot, that presence is a bitter disgrace.

Fel Rock lies north of the nearby paths, its corrupted caverns crawling with feral grell. Lord Melenas has gathered the chaotic creatures into a hostile force under his will. Tallonkai fears what the satyr may unleash on the World Tree’s boughs, and demands a swift, quiet end. He wants Melenas eliminated and his severed head brought back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I must warn you, friend, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.
He is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.
You must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, friend. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. Thank you, friend.
